I need to verify the common alternative name for the rowan tree.

The rowan tree (Sorbus aucuparia) is indeed commonly known as the Mountain Ash. This is a well-established common name for this tree, despite it not being a true ash (which belongs to the genus Fraxinus). The name "Mountain Ash" comes from the similarity of its leaves to those of ash trees and its tendency to grow in mountainous regions.

Both agents provided the same answer with high confidence, and this aligns with my knowledge of this botanical fact.

Answer: Ash
Confidence: 0.98
